title: CSL Finance appoints Akshay Gujar as CEO of SME division
content:
CSL Finance  has appointed Akshay Gujar as the Chief Executive Officer of its SME Division, effective October 27, 2026. The appointment designates him as Senior Management Personnel, strengthening the company's leadership in the small and medium enterprise lending segment.

## Appointment details and regulatory compliance [...] Preeti Gupta, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the disclosure for the company. The filing confirms that the reason for the change is an appointment, with no cessation of existing personnel mentioned in this specific disclosure.

## Professional background of Akshay Gujar [...] The appointment was disclosed in compliance with Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company cited SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFDPOD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, regarding detailed disclosures for changes in senior management.

title: Deputy appoints Silvija Martincevic as global CEO
content:
Deputy, the shift management platform, has today announced the appointment of its new Chief Executive Officer, Silvija Martincevic, to scale the business as it reaches a milestone of securing $100M in annual recurring revenue servicing 330,000 workplaces and 1.3 million shift workers globally.
